readerCopy.body: One side wants to preserve the relationship and the pleasant plan, while the other can no longer ignore what the arrangement costs at home. A trip, purchase, party, or recurring favor looks reasonable from the outside but keeps taking time, money, or care from the same person. The Moon makes the private cost impossible to smooth over, while Venus holds the agreement and the wish to avoid disappointing anyone. The opposition forces the pleasant plan to face what it has been costing at home. A compromise may save the plan, but only if affection stops being used as a reason the burden should remain invisible.
